settings.editor: A charger should fit how the vehicle is actually used, where it parks, and what the electrical panel can support. Some homes need faster charging, while others only need reliable overnight recovery. Planning around the routine helps avoid paying for a setup that is larger or less practical than necessary.

The best charging setup is the one that restores the range you need without creating avoidable electrical work. Daily mileage, available charging time, charger settings and cable reach all matter. When those details are clear, the installation can be matched to the property instead of guessed from the car alone.
